IssuerRegistry.note: Issuers and borrowers are separate rolls. Reading borrowers out of the issuer list gave every admitted borrower the right to mint. Also holds approveMint, keyed by NoteFactory.mintHash.

NoteFactory.note: Issuer must be a registered issuer, borrower a registered borrower, and the exact parameters approved.
NoteFactory.verification: Unverified. OKLink's plugin endpoint accepts the submission and then cannot reproduce the bytecode. It is scale rather than settings: IssuerRegistry (1 source, 4.3KB) and SaleDesk (11 sources, 5.6KB) both verify, while this is 26 sources and 22.2KB because the factory embeds the note and vault creation code. Compiler settings are pinned and it still fails.

MockUSDG.warning: TESTNET ONLY. Minting is unrestricted, so this token is worthless as money. On mainnet, point RepaymentVault at the real USDG instead.

SaleDesk.note: Charges 25 bps to each side of a primary sale. The buyer pays the price plus 25 bps, the seller receives it less 25 bps, and both legs go to the treasury in the same transaction. Rate and treasury are immutable.

demo.note_: Deployed empty and left empty: no issuer or borrower is admitted, so onboarding runs through the app. Notes under the superseded factories remain on-chain and are no longer indexed.

compiler.note: Pinned so the toolchain cannot change deployed bytecode under a live contract, and so a verifier compiles at the same target.
